body:
> Surfaced by the review of PR #173 (#166), not verified — Copilot CLI is not installed on this host.

## Why

The current Copilot CLI hooks reference (docs.github.com, hooks-configuration) documents a top-level `"version": 1` (required) and a **flat array** of hooks per event, each with a `bash` / `powershell` command key. `templates/copilot/hooks.json` writes the Claude-Code-nested shape — `hooks: [{ type: "command", command }]` with no `version`. If the reference is authoritative, Copilot never reads the `command` hkb writes, so the `agentStop` nudge (`docs/harnesses.md`) has never fired there — and #166's project-relative rewrite of that command is moot for Copilot.

## What

- Confirm against the reference (and a live `copilot` run if one is available: does an `agentStop` hook fire with the shape we write? with the documented shape?).
- If the documented shape is right: rewrite `templates/copilot/hooks.json` and the writer/reader in `src/init.js` (`installHarness`, `harnessHookCommand`), keep the project-relative command from #166, update `docs/harnesses.md`'s Copilot rows, and add a test that the generated file matches the reference shape.
- If hkb's shape is also accepted: say so in `docs/harnesses.md` with the reference link, and add `version: 1` if it is required either way.

## Done when

- A test asserts the generated Copilot hooks file has the shape the reference documents.
- `docs/harnesses.md` states which shape Copilot reads and how it was verified.
goal: hkb init --harness copilot writes a hooks file Copilot CLI actually reads, verified against the current reference or a live run
title: Copilot hooks file: verify the shape hkb writes against Copilot CLI's current hooks reference (version: 1, flat array, bash/powershell keys)
